legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of the provisions of section 286, the order under section 294 shall be passed within eighteen months from the end of the quarter in which the search was initiated or requisition was made.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(1): Irrespective of the provisions of section 286, the order under section 294 shall be passed within eighteen months from the end of the quarter in which the search was initiated or requisition was made.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: Where search was initiated or requisition was made, and during the course of assessment or reassessment of the total undisclosed income of the relevant block period, any reference under section 166(1) is made, the period available for completion of such assessment or reassessment proceeding shall be extended by twelve months.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(2): Where search was initiated or requisition was made, and during the course of assessment or reassessment of the total undisclosed income of the relevant block period, any reference under section 166(1) is made, the period available for completion of such assessment or reassessment proceeding shall be extended by twelve months.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: In computing the period of limitation under sub-section (1), the period (not exceeding one hundred and eighty days) commencing from the date on which a search is initiated or a requisition is made and ending on the date on which assets [as provided in section 261(b)] and material seized or requisitioned [as provided in section 261(i)] are handed over to the Assessing Officer having jurisdiction over the assessee shall be excluded.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(3): In computing the period of limitation under sub-section (1), the period (not exceeding one hundred and eighty days) commencing from the date on which a search is initiated or a requisition is made and ending on the date on which assets [as provided in section 261(b)] and material seized or requisitioned [as provided in section 261(i)] are handed over to the Assessing Officer having jurisdiction over the assessee shall be excluded.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: If after exclusion of the period referred to in sub-section (3), the remaining period of limitation for completion of assessment or reassessment, expires before the end of a month, such period shall be extended to end of such month.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(4): If after exclusion of the period referred to in sub-section (3), the remaining period of limitation for completion of assessment or reassessment, expires before the end of a month, such period shall be extended to end of such month.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: The period of limitation for completion of assessment or reassessment for the block period in the case of the other person referred to in section 295 shall be twelve months from the end of the quarter in which the notice under section 294 in pursuance of section 295, was issued to such other person.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(5): The period of limitation for completion of assessment or reassessment for the block period in the case of the other person referred to in section 295 shall be twelve months from the end of the quarter in which the notice under section 294 in pursuance of section 295, was issued to such other person.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: The period available for completion of assessment or reassessment proceeding in respect of the block period in a case referred to in sub-section (5) shall be extended by twelve months, where a reference under section 166(1) is made in such case.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(6): The period available for completion of assessment or reassessment proceeding in respect of the block period in a case referred to in sub-section (5) shall be extended by twelve months, where a reference under section 166(1) is made in such case.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: Where immediately after the exclusion of the period referred to in sub-section (3) or (7), the remaining period of limitation referred to in sub-section (1) or (5) available to the Assessing Officer for completion of assessment under section 294 is less than sixty days, such remaining period shall be extended to sixty days and the aforesaid period of limitation shall be deemed to be extended accordingly.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 296 Time-limit for completion of block assessment. Section 296(8): Where immediately after the exclusion of the period referred to in sub-section (3) or (7), the remaining period of limitation referred to in sub-section (1) or (5) available to the Assessing Officer for completion of assessment under section 294 is less than sixty days, such remaining period shall be extended to sixty days and the aforesaid period of limitation shall be deemed to be extended accordingly.

legal_units.title: Time-limit for completion of block assessment.
legal_units.text: Where after extension of the period referred to in sub-section (8), the period of limitation for making an order of assessment or reassessment, expires before the end of a month, such period shall be extended to the end of such month.
